description.value: You chirp a short jingle, which can serve as a message to those who hear and understand the tune. This could convey a short command or indication. While people who you’ve taught the meaning of the message can understand it immediately, those who do not must pass a Perception check against your Performance DC or Deception DC (whichever is higher) to discern it as a message, though they are unlikely to understand its meaning without seeing it repeated. A person who hears the chirp but does not know it is coming from you would also need to pass a similar check to realize it is a person making the jingle and not another chirping animal.
